LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 6.3.1 COMPARISON OF ADVERBS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.3: Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Comparison of Adverbs

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Comparison of Adverbs. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do we compare things?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the degrees of comparison in adverbs
2. use positive, comparative and superlative degrees of adverbs in sentences
3. appreciate the importance of the correct usage of adverbs

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 6.3.1 COMPARISON OF ADVERBS
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Comparison of Adverbs for Grade 9 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the degrees of comparison in adverbs
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use positive, comparative and superlative degrees of adverbs in sentences
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the importance of the correct usage of adverbs
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Comparison of Adverbs using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Comparison of Adverbs above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Comparison of Adverbs to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Comparison of Adverbs.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Comparison of Adverbs with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Comparison of Adverbs important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we compare things?
2. Which words are used to make comparison?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the degrees of comparison in adverbs
2. use positive, comparative and superlative degrees of adverbs in sentences
3. appreciate the importance of the correct usage of adverbs
